'''Crossover: Supplemental''' is the 26th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on September 25, 2015. The set consists of 80 cards. This set is part of the ''Mirror Universe Block'' consisting of cards from [[Crossover (expansion)|Crossover]], [[Crossover: Supplemental]], [[Through the Looking Glass]], and [[The Terran Empire]].

==Type Breakdown==
*4 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
*1 [[:Category:Doorway (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Doorway]]
*4 [[:Category:Equipment (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Equipment]]
*4 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*1 [[:Category:Facility (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Facility]] (1 Cardassian)
*7 [[:Category:Incident (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Incident]]
*8 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*1 [[:Category:Objective (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Objective]]
*42 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (5 Bajoran, 5 Cardassian, 18 Federation, 4 Ferengi, 7 Klingon and 4 Non-Aligned)
*7 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (1 Cardassian, 4 Federation and 2 Klingon)
*1 [[:Category:Time Location (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Time Location]]

'''NOTE:''' There is 1 Dual Affiliations card, thus the totals are higher than the amount of a card type.

==Trivia==
*This expansion’s icon is the multidimensional transporter device from the Star Trek: Deep Space Nine episode “Through the Looking Glass”. It is of a different color of the icon for the [[Crossover (expansion)|Crossover]] expansion.
